exercises.title: Yes, No or Not Given? A short text (Ex. 2)
exercises.instruction: Read the short text. Do the statements agree with the views of the writer? Write YES, NO or NOT GIVEN.

stimulus.text:
It is commonly believed that taking steps to protect the environment is morally the right thing to do. What is sadly evident, however, is that we all have friends and family who do not concern themselves at all with tackling this problem.

The number one reason for this is that, for some, it is just inconvenient. Other people just do not feel that their contribution makes a difference. Fortunately, however, the majority of us do give it the attention it deserves and many people go to great lengths to ensure the planet is protected for future generations.
stimulus.caption: A short text (p. 109)

items.prompt: Some people do not pay attention to environmental issues because they do not believe their involvement would make an impact.
items.explanation: "Other people just do not feel that their **contribution makes a difference**" (involvement ↔ contribution; make an impact ↔ makes a difference).

items.prompt: Some people tackle environmental problems in the wrong way.
items.explanation: Bài không nói gì về việc giải quyết vấn đề "sai cách".

items.prompt: Most people do not care about environmental issues.
items.explanation: "the **majority of us** do give it the attention it deserves" → trái ngược.

items.prompt: Some people do a great deal to protect the environment.
items.explanation: "many people **go to great lengths** to ensure the planet is protected" (do a great deal ↔ go to great lengths).

exercises.title: Distractors in the summary (Ex. 8)
exercises.instruction: Look at the words in the box in exercise 7 (carefully, quickly, entertaining, animal, conservation, reproduce, younger). Which words are distractors, and where would they have been grammatically correct?

items.prompt: "quickly" is a distractor. In which gap would it have been grammatically correct?
items.explanation: Gap 3 cần trạng từ — quickly đúng ngữ pháp nhưng sai nghĩa (bài nói "manage the programmes carefully").

items.prompt: "animal" is a distractor. In which gap would it have been grammatically correct?
items.explanation: "animal projects" đúng ngữ pháp nhưng bài nói về conservation projects.

exercises.title: Agree or disagree (Ex. 6)
exercises.instruction: Answer using so, too, either and neither. More than one answer is possible.

items.explanation: Đồng ý với câu khẳng định, trợ động từ do.

items.prompt: 'I would love to go on a safari holiday.' (disagree) → '____'
items.explanation: Không đồng ý với "I would…" → I wouldn't.

items.prompt: 'I don't know anything about endangered species.' (agree) → '____'
items.explanation: Đồng ý với câu phủ định → neither / either.

exercises.title: Choose the correct quantifier (Ex. 5)
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct quantifier in these sentences.

items.prompt: ___ of the renewable energy sources, such as wind and wave power, have been developed and used around the world.
Although coal is still widely used, ___ more gas is used instead these days.
___ non-renewable resources have negative effects on the environment.
items.explanation: Every + danh từ số ít; resources số nhiều → All.

items.prompt: ___ energy production in the UK comes from wind turbines.
There are not ___ suitable sites for solar power in the UK.
items.explanation: sites đếm được, số nhiều → a lot of.
